claim.statement: Cognition's authentication reference distinguishes service-user API keys from closed-beta human Personal Access Tokens; says service-user-created sessions are attributed to the service user by default; and requires ImpersonateOrgSessions when create_as_user_id attributes a session to a specific human user.

source.title: Authentication
source.locator: Credential principal distinction; Service users; Session attribution with create_as_user_id; Personal access tokens

limitations: Documented identity and permission rules do not establish the principal, target or successful authorization of any request.
unknowns: The credential type, service user, target human, roles, organization membership and audit attribution are unknown.
